name: Spoon
summary: This small spoon was probably used by communities in South Asia for eating soup and rice porridge. It is one of a number of objects that was salvaged from the wreck of a trade ship thought to be a Chinese junk, dating to approximately 1725. This corresponds to the reign of the Kangxi emperor (1662-1
